text:
Priya R: Heads-up  weve got a lot to lock for the launch post series + webinar funnel. Need canonical plan, hreflang for EU, schema for event/speakers, and a redirect matrix for the short promo links. Can someone take the redirect matrix?
Marco: Im on redirects. Ill create direct 301s for any legacy slugs and avoid chains. Proposed new canonical for the series: /resources/launches/2026-inference-suite as the hub.
Tess: For keywords, split into 3 clusters: "inference cost optimization", "redwood inference benchmark", "low-latency llm serving". Each cluster gets a pillar post + internal links from docs and product pages.
Alex: On hreflang  landing will be EN-US and EN-GB variants. We'll add <link rel=\"alternate\" hreflang=\"en-GB\" href=\"https://redwood.ai/uk/resources/launches/2026-inference-suite\" /> and canonical always pointing to the canonical hub.
Priya R: Schema for webinar: event + Person for speakers. Make sure to include offers (free) and url.
Tess: Example JSON-LD (will paste to CMS snippet):
```json
{"@context":"https://schema.org","@type":"Event","name":"Redwood Inference Launch: Performance & Cost","startDate":"2026-06-02T18:00:00Z","location":{"@type":"VirtualLocation","url":"https://redwood.ai/webinars/launch-june2026"},"performer":[{"@type":"Person","name":"Dr. Maya Chen","affiliation":{"@type":"Organization","name":"Redwood Inference"}},{"@type":"Person","name":"Jordan Lee","affiliation":{"@type":"Organization","name":"Redwood Inference"}}],"offers":{"@type":"Offer","url":"https://redwood.ai/webinars/launch-june2026/register","price":0,"availability":"https://schema.org/InStock"}}
```
Marco: Redirect shortlinks plan:
- /r/launch -> /resources/launches/2026-inference-suite (301)
- /r/bench -> /resources/benchmarks/2026-inference-bench (301)
- /webinar/may -> /webinars/launch-june2026 (301)
Avoid interim redirects like /old -> /blog -> /resources.
Alex: Also set canonical headers on the EU pages to point to the EN-GB canonical and add HSTS header on redirects.
Priya R: GTM events  need a signup event that captures utm_campaign and session_id. Also need to verify the lead routing: webinar signups should create leads tagged 'webinar_launch_2026' and route to SDR queue A.
Tess: I'll update the content plan and add internal linking map: docs/perf -> pillar post, product/pricing -> anchor to 'cost optimization' post, blog -> benchmark post. Use descriptive anchor text, avoid exact-match over-optimization.
Marco: SEO Bot, run a link equity simulation for the proposed internal linking and show expected PageRank gain for the hub page? @seo-bot
SEO Bot: queued: link-sim-1790012345. ETA ~7m. Also running redirect-audit for any live chains.
Alex: Small note: ensure rel=canonical on translated pages does NOT point to a different language without hreflang pairings.
Priya R: Great. Action owners: Marco  implement redirects & shortlink 301s; Tess  update content plan + internal link map; Alex  add hreflang/canonical headers and GTM event check; Priya  finalize launch checklist and publish. Deadline Monday EOD.
Marco: I'll drop the redirect nginx snippets in the doc after I run a quick audit.
SEO Bot: redirect-audit-1790012345 complete: found 1 chain: /r/oldlaunch -> /blog/launch-2025 -> /resources/launches/2026-inference-suite. Recommend direct 301 from /r/oldlaunch. Link-sim results sent to Priya R DM.
Priya R: Thanks all. I'll adjust the checklist and ping product for the doc links.
